UserPrivateAccount.title: UserPrivateAccount
UserPrivateAccount.description: Private user account record containing PII isolated from public discovery.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when account was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Public creator profile used in Discover search and Profile views without PII.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

username.description: Public handle (3-30 lowercase alphanumeric, underscore, or dot characters).

discoverable.description: Whether the profile appears in Discover queries.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest profile update.

VideoPost.title: VideoPost
VideoPost.description: Short-video metadata document prepared for Firebase Storage media URLs.

visibility.description: Visibility scope of the video post.

lastCommentId.description: Most recent comment document ID written atomically during comment create or delete.

viewsCount.description: Optional total public video view count.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest post update.

VynozaNotification.title: VynozaNotification
VynozaNotification.description: User-scoped activity notification for likes, comments, followers, and system notices.

recipientId.description: Target recipient UID matching parent path.

actorId.description: UID of the user who triggered the notification.

read.description: Whether the recipient has read the notification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the notification was created.

FollowEdge.title: FollowEdge
FollowEdge.description: Directed follow relationship stored under the follower's following subcollection.

targetUserId.description: Followed creator UID matching document ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when follow relationship was created.

FollowerEdge.title: FollowerEdge
FollowerEdge.description: Zero-PII reciprocal follower record stored under the followed creator's followers subcollection and kept atomically in sync with /users/{followerId}/following/{targetUserId} and followersCount.

targetUserId.description: Followed creator UID matching parent path.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when follower relationship was created.

VideoLike.title: VideoLike
VideoLike.description: Idempotent per-user video like record stored atomically alongside the video likesCount.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID who liked the video.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the video was liked.

VideoComment.title: VideoComment
VideoComment.description: User-authored comment on a video post, stored under /videos/{videoId}/comments/{commentId} and synchronized atomically with commentsCount.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the comment was created.

SavedVideo.title: SavedVideo
SavedVideo.description: Owner-scoped saved/bookmarked video record preventing duplicates per user.

videoId.description: Saved video document ID matching document ID.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID matching parent path.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the video was saved.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only private user account PII and metadata.

/users_public/{userId}.description: Public creator profiles without PII for Profile and Discover views.

/videos/{videoId}.description: Short-video post metadata for Home feed, Discover search, and Profile uploads.

/videos/{videoId}/likes/{userId}.description: Canonical per-user like records preventing duplicate likes and securing atomic likesCount updates.

/videos/{videoId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Per-video comments with strict author ownership and atomic commentsCount coupling.

/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificat.description: Owner-scoped notifications for likes, comments, and followers.

/users/{userId}/following/{targetUserId}.description: Owner-scoped following edges coupled atomically with /users/{targetUserId}/followers/{userId}.

/users/{userId}/followers/{followerUserI.description: Zero-PII follower records stored under the followed user and synchronized atomically with following edges and followersCount.

/users/{userId}/liked_videos/{videoId}.description: Owner-scoped liked video index kept atomically in sync with /videos/{videoId}/likes/{userId}.

/users/{userId}/saved_videos/{videoId}.description: Owner-only saved/bookmarked videos list preventing duplicates and cross-user access.
